sent:
Milo —

Meta has rolled out GEM, a unified model that auto‑optimises creative and placements across Facebook, Instagram, Reels and Stories. Helpful, but there’s no verified CVR/CPA uplift for food & drink yet—don’t price gains into January.

One action: in week one, run a clean placement split. Ad Set A: all placements on (incl. Reels/Stories). Ad Set B: Feed‑only. Keep audience, budget and creative identical (ship variants in threes) and send both to the same single‑offer page. Hold 5–7 days (or ~50 first orders per cell), judge on first‑order CPA and page CVR by placement. Keep the cheaper placements, retire the rest, then continue the creative‑in‑threes cadence.
